name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She rises on tiptoe with the staff raised in one hand and her other arm flung wide, her hair, ribbons and gown streaming in the gale, chin lifted, a joyful, radiant gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.expression: a playful, knowing smile, eyes bright with mischief.
components.effects: A great spiral of wind lifts ribbons, banners, leaves and feathers around her, glowing {{MAGIC}} ribbons of air trace the currents, the lyre strings glow and a ring of drifting chimes sings in the air.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Zephyros, swooping in close beside her with its wings spread across the sky, windswept-jade and gossamer-silver scales, trailing wisps of racing cloud, wings like vast sails of sea-glass silk

notes: HOLO edition 'Voice of the Wind': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
